remote_playback_surface_label: Example casting, AirPlay, and second-screen posture for official voter-information media routes
delivery_role_note: The service reviews remote-playback and second-screen modes so casting, AirPlay, Chromecast, Miracast, and similar transfer routes remain subordinate to the full recording and the current written help lane rather than quietly becoming a stripped-down stand-alone official answer surface on a TV or external display.

reviewed_remote_playback_contexts.context_note: Reviewed whether the official recording can move to a TV or receiver through casting and whether the sending device remains the practical controller for what plays and what queues next.
Reviewed whether AirPlay or similar second-screen suggestions can move the recording onto a familiar display and what official source/help cues remain recoverable after the handoff.
Reviewed whether mirrored or projected display modes hide the current written route, correction note, or named help lane that still governs volatile operational questions.
Reviewed whether queue state, controller surfaces, or nearby-device participation can change what appears on the remote display without the remote screen itself carrying full authority context.

remote_playback_boundary_note: Remote playback is treated as a convenience route around the official recording, not as a replacement for the full watch page, linked FAQ/help route, or correction posture.
split_context_note: The service reviews which freshness, scope, and help cues stay on the sending device after playback moves to a remote screen and does not treat the remote display as self-sufficient authority.
queue_and_controller_note: If the platform exposes a TV queue, local-network control, or receiver-side follow-on state, the route treats that behavior as an adjacent platform surface rather than proof that the second-screen view is the office's full reviewed answer lane.
source_page_recovery_note: When remote playback is available, the voter should still have a practical route back to the current source page, current written help entry, or named office contact before acting on volatile instructions.
receiver_behavior_note: Where casting or mirroring availability can vary by player, embed, or owner settings, the service avoids promising universal support and records which modes were actually reviewed.
